title: spec(ui): a navigation group that says nothing opens — GroupNavItem expanded defaults to true
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWwk9BkRgZKVzh5DadYMEZV)_
Fixes #26370

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` states or implies the old default: `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` lists `expanded` on the group row with no default, and `rules/navigation.md` writes `expanded: true` out, so both read true under the flip, and no `objectstack-ui` eval exercises the key. The docs half is in this diff: `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` (Group Navigation) now says a group opens unless it declares `expanded: false`, and the generated `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx` carries the new describe text.

Ruling-ref: 6431302164 (batch #405 item 1, letter A, maintainer 「同意」)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：导航分组 `expanded` 的默认值从 `false` 改成 `true`，不写就展开；想折叠要写 `expanded: false`。附一条 ADR-0087 D3 语义迁移条目、默认值变更声明和 changeset。
- 为什么改：按裁决 A，协议跟上控制台已经裁定的行为。实测：经 `defineStack` 解析的应用（showcase）以前给 8 个没写 `expanded` 的分组都下发了 `expanded: false`，控制台照此折叠；平台自带的 Setup/Account 不经解析，没写就不下发，控制台展开。两种来源结果相反，现在统一为展开。
- 风险与回滚：已编译的旧 `objectstack.json` 里写死了 `false`，那些分组仍会折叠，重新编译即可。回滚就是还原这一行默认值和迁移条目。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`（默认值与描述）、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-nav-group-expanded-default-open.ts`、`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/app.test.ts`，预期 GroupNavItemSchema 四个用例全绿：不写解析为 `true`，写 `false` 仍为 `false`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `GroupNavItemSchema.expanded` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`) is now `z.boolean().default(true)`. Its describe says what each value does: omitted opens, `false` keeps the group closed until the user opens it, and a group holding the current route opens whatever it declares.
- ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry `ui-nav-group-expanded-default-open` (major 18). It carries the change to `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide. It is the same class as `list-view-edit-inline-default-on` and `view-pagination-page-size-default-50`: no key removed, no tombstone, no D2 conversion.
- `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR[18]` declares `ui/GroupNavItem:expanded` false → true. The spec build refused the flip until it was declared.
- Generated: `packages/spec/authorable-defaults/ui.json` (one line) and `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx` (the describe text, five tables). Hand-written: one sentence in `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, with the two declaration lines.
- No renderer change. `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` (the `explicitOpen` block, about lines 1538-1550) opens on `true` and on an absent key and closes on `false`. After the flip the served shape is `true` or absent for every silent group, so the served shape and the renderer agree.

## Why

The maintainer ruled letter A on #26370 (6431302164): a navigation group that says nothing opens, and an author who wants it closed writes `expanded: false`, as `setup.app.ts:116` and `account.app.ts:186` already do.

### Triage P3, measured (the hypothesis was half true)

The served navigation DOES apply the spec default, for every app that goes through a parse. It does not for apps registered raw.

| app | producer | served groups on `origin/main` (e931621a) | served groups on this branch (2f3905e2; the merge adds nothing under `packages/spec/src/ui`) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `showcase_app` | `defineStack` (parsed; the compiled `dist/objectstack.json` carries the same) | all 8 groups `expanded: false`, none authored | all 8 groups `expanded: true` |
| `setup` | raw `App` object, registered without a parse | 8 groups with no key, `group_advanced` `false` (authored) | unchanged |
| `account` | raw `App` object | inbox `true`, security `true`, developer `false` (all authored) | unchanged |

The registry's `validate()` parse is a diagnostic only and stores the raw item (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, the spec-conformance block), so a raw app never gains the default. `defineStack` in strict mode returns the parsed stack, so a parsed app always does. On main this made the two kinds of app behave oppositely in the console: the showcase's groups arrived with a written `false` and collapsed, and Setup's arrived with no key and opened. After the flip, both open.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.test.ts`: the silent-group case now expects `true`. New cases: an authored `false` stays `false`; a non-boolean is refused at path `expanded`; a silent group in a parsed app opens while an authored nested `false` stays closed.

## Acceptance notes

- The migration entry and the default-change reason name the compiled-artifact case. A document that serialised an earlier parse carries a written `false` and its groups stay closed until it is recompiled or the key is deleted.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` step 2 says "QA run found Setup's Configuration group collapsed as well". That records an earlier run and stays true as history. Setup's Configuration group declares no `expanded` and is served without the key, so it opens on main and on this branch. Not edited here.
- Browser rendering was not re-measured. The open or closed reading follows from the served shape above and the renderer's `explicitOpen` block.

The spec build refused the flip once until `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR` declared it (`ui/GroupNavItem:expanded: false -> true`),
and `check:generated --fix` regenerated `check:docs` only.

`packages/cli` `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` (integration tier; reads every semantic entry for tracker ids) is declared to
CI's Test Core. The new entry's printed fields carry 0 tracker ids (scanned).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` was not run locally: the repo-wide scan is CI's (`Lint & Repo Gates`).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
